# The reviewed differences between Python pm's pages and Go pm's, after Normalise (internal/site/parity_test.go).
# Each entry is a block of `key: value` lines, entries apart by a blank line:
#   name:   a short name
#   reason: why Go's page may differ here; reviewed in the PR that adds the entry
#   pages:  where it applies: corpus:glob ..., corpus being fixtures, constructs or live, glob as Go's path.Match
#   python: a Go regexp over Python's normalised page
#   go:     its replacement ($1 for a group), Go's form
# An entry that matches no page of a corpus it names fails the test, so the list only holds live differences.

name: assignee
reason: Python's task graph labels a task not done with its bd assignee ("· yeeef"); the work store has no assignee, its holder is a session and never a person (work-store page, Data model), so Go's graph names nobody
pages: live:projects/*.html live:sprints/*.html
python: (?m) · [^·\n]+?(&#34;\]:::(?:running|ready|blocked)$)
go: $1

name: reply-command
reason: a decision need's card names the shell command that answers it; Python pm's is bd human respond, Go pm's pm reply add, as bd is gone at the cut-over (work-store page, Commands)
pages: fixtures:*.html fixtures:*/*.html constructs:*.html constructs:*/*.html live:*.html live:*/*.html
python: <code>bd human respond ([^<]+)</code>
go: <code>pm reply add $1</code>

name: awaiting-decisions-source
reason: the Decisions await you prompt names where its cards come from: Python pm's Beads issues labelled human without action, Go pm's work store, whose needs have a kind instead of labels (work-store page, Data model)
pages: fixtures:*.html fixtures:*/*.html constructs:*.html constructs:*/*.html live:*.html live:*/*.html
python: Generated from Beads: open issues labelled <code>human</code>, without <code>action</code>\.
go: Generated from the work store: open decision needs.

name: awaiting-actions-source
reason: the Actions await you prompt names where its cards come from: Python pm's Beads issues labelled human and action, Go pm's work store, whose action and PR review needs it shows (work-store page, Data model)
pages: fixtures:*.html fixtures:*/*.html constructs:*.html constructs:*/*.html live:*.html live:*/*.html
python: Generated from Beads: open issues labelled <code>human</code> and <code>action</code>\.
go: Generated from the work store: open action and PR review needs.

name: day-sprints-source
reason: a day page's Sprints section names where its activity comes from: Beads in Python pm, the work store in Go pm
pages: fixtures:days/*.html constructs:days/*.html live:days/*.html
python: (Generated from|No sprint activity in) Beads(: tasks opened| on this day)
go: $1 the work store$2
